title: Google announces Gemini 3.5 Transcribe for AI-powered speech-to-text
summary: Google has introduced Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, an AI model designed to improve voice-to-text transcription by editing out disfluencies like 'ums' and corrections, delivering polished text output. The model is 70% faster than its predecessor, Chirp 3, with a live-speech error rate of 5.5% (down from 7.32%). It supports 85 languages, handles specialized jargon via custom vocabulary, and can process up to three speakers in pre-recorded audio. The model is already integrated into Gboard's 'Rambler' feature on Pixel 11, the Gemini macOS app, and developer tools like Antigravity and AI Studio. Future expansions include Chrome browser integration.
